source.data:
@api
Feature: Practice API contracts and diagnostic evidence
  Background:
    Given the local API is healthy

  Scenario: Create a practice session from a JSON document
    When I POST this JSON to the practice API:
      """json
      {"word":"persevere"}
      """
    Then the response status is 201
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field | value     |
      | word  | persevere |
      | saved | true      |

  Scenario Outline: Query practice word metadata (<word>)
    When I GET metadata for "<word>"
    Then the response status is 200
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field  | value    |
      | word   | <word>   |
      | length | <length> |
      | kind   | practice |

    Examples:
      | word      | length |
      | persevere | 9      |
      | focus     | 5      |

  Scenario: Expected validation error is not a business failure
    When I submit an empty practice word expecting status 400
    Then the response status is 400
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field | value         |
      | error | word_required |
    And I record a non-fatal diagnostic comparison

@api @independent
Feature: Practice API - independent consumer contract checks
  As an API automation tester adopting the 2.0.1 client,
  I want request/response evidence, tables and JSON in ReportPortal
  so that I can diagnose a failed contract without re-running it.

  Background:
    Given the local API is healthy

  Scenario: Save a word that uses accents, CJK and emoji
    When I POST this JSON to the practice API:
      """json
      {"word": "résumé 中文 ✓"}
      """
    Then the response status is 201
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field | value       |
      | word  | résumé 中文 ✓ |
      | saved | true        |

  Scenario: Metadata length counts characters, not bytes
    When I GET metadata for "naïve"
    Then the response status is 200
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field  | value |
      | word   | naïve |
      | length | 5     |

  Scenario Outline: Reject a practice payload that has no usable word (<case>)
    When I POST the raw body <payload> expecting status 400
    Then the response status is 400
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field | value         |
      | error | word_required |

    Examples:
      | case            | payload          |
      | empty string    | {"word": ""}     |
      | whitespace only | {"word": "   "}  |
      | number          | {"word": 42}     |
      | missing field   | {}               |
      | JSON array      | ["persevere"]    |

  Scenario: Reject a word longer than 80 characters
    When I POST a word of 81 letters expecting status 400
    Then the response status is 400

  Scenario: Malformed JSON gets a request error, not a server crash
    When I POST the raw body {"word": "unterminated expecting status 400
    Then the response status is 400
    And the JSON response includes:
      | field | value                   |
      | error | invalid_json_or_request |

  Scenario: Routing errors use the right status codes
    When I send DELETE to "/api/practice" expecting status 405
    Then the response status is 405
    When I send GET to "/api/unknown" expecting status 404
    Then the response status is 404

  @intentional_failure
  Scenario: Metadata contract matches the published example exactly
    When I GET metadata for "focus"
    Then the response body matches this JSON exactly:
      """json
      {
        "word": "focus",
        "length": 5,
        "kind": "practice",
        "difficulty": "easy"
      }
      """

  @intentional_failure
  Scenario: Saved word echoes the submitted text verbatim
    When I POST this JSON to the practice API:
      """json
      {"word": "line one"}
      """
    Then the saved word equals this text:
      """
      line one
      line two
      """

@ui @independent Feature: Practice page - independent UI journeys As a UI automation tester adopting the 2.0.1 client, I want step-owned screenshots and clear failure evidence in ReportPortal so that I can see what the browser showed at each important moment. Background: Given I open the local practice page Scenario: Save a word with accents, CJK and emoji When I practice the word "résumé 中文 ✓" Then the practice status is "Saved: résumé 中文 ✓" And I keep a screenshot of the page as evidence Scenario: The browser blocks an empty submission When I submit the practice form without a word Then the practice status is "Ready to practice" Scenario: Typing is capped at 80 characters When I type 100 letters into the practice word field Then the practice word field holds 80 characters Scenario: Practise several words in a row When I practice these words in order: | word | note | | focus | short | | persevere | from the docs | | 継続 | Japanese "continue" | Then the practice status is "Saved: 継続" And I keep a screenshot of the page as evidence Scenario Outline: Each saved word is echoed back () When I practice the word "" Then the practice status is "Saved: " Examples: | word | | calm | | O'Brien | | bold | @intentional_failure Scenario: Status copy uses the new punctuation style When I practice the word "persevere" Then the practice status is "Saved: persevere!"

@ui @live
Feature: Optional live Typewords smoke check
  Scenario: Open the locally hosted Typewords landing page
    Given I open Typewords
    Then the browser title contains "TypeWords"

@api @tester_api
Feature: API tester workplace response contracts
  Scenario: Save a practice word at the supported length boundary
    Given the API tester prepares a practice word of 80 characters
    When the API tester submits the prepared practice word
    Then the API tester verifies the creation response

  @intentional_failure
  Scenario: Metadata includes the difficulty required by the consuming application
    When the API tester retrieves metadata for "focus"
    Then the API tester expects the following metadata contract:
      """json
      {"word":"focus","length":5,"kind":"practice","difficulty":"easy"}
      """

@ui @tester_ui
Feature: Workday practice checkpoints
  A colleague should be able to follow a saved-word journey from the report.

  Scenario: Correct a typo and save the replacement using the keyboard
    Given I open the local practice page
    When the UI tester saves "handvoer" using Enter
    And the UI tester replaces the word with "handover" using Enter
    Then the practice status is "Saved: handover"
    And the UI tester records the "corrected-word-saved" checkpoint

  @intentional_failure
  Scenario: Recover the last saved word after an accidental refresh
    Given I open the local practice page
    When the UI tester saves "follow-up" using Enter
    Then the practice status is "Saved: follow-up"
    And the UI tester records the "saved-before-refresh" checkpoint
    When the UI tester refreshes the practice page
    Then the UI tester finds the restored word "follow-up"

@ui
Feature: Browser interactions with a deterministic local page
  Background:
    Given I open the local practice page

  Scenario: Save a practice word
    When I practice the word "persevere"
    Then the practice status is "Saved: persevere"

  @intentional_failure
  Scenario: Missing locator preserves its Playwright error and screenshot
    When I click the deliberately missing practice button
